title: Linear-size commutative semigroup circuits for complements of sparse Boolean matrices
author: Alexander S. Kulikov, Ivan Mikhailin, Andrey Mokhov, and Vladimir V. Podolskii
source_version: Theory of Computing 21 (2025), Article 9, publisher source publication November 10, 2025; DOI 10.4086/toc.2025.v021a009

selected_assertion_scope.note: Full exact compound theorem is the canonical carrier because source382 contains both the end of the complete primary circuit-existence assertion and onset of the unselected runtime paragraph. difficulty_reason: The selected circuit-existence assertion combines row classification by zero count with regular-circuit transposition and block range preprocessing, avoiding subtraction or inverses in a general commutative semigroup. Its complete deterministic author route constructs a column permutation that confines short ranges to a small terminal stripe while maintaining a zero-count invariant. That new structural compression establishes linear size in the number of zeroes, whereas the additional randomized and deterministic circuit-generation time bounds are unselected context and are not used as separate qualification claims.
